resources.string: Removes the local data this app stores on this device. The server is never changed.

This erases, on this device only:
• the live authenticated session (disconnect)
• your server credential (SecureStore)
• the stored server profile and its identity pin
• the encrypted cache (database, sidecars and key)
• the notifications posted by the app

Your server, its sessions and its messages are not touched. The cache is rebuilt from the server on the next connection.
Local data erased. Connect to a server to build the cache again.
The erase did not finish. Some local data may remain.
Authentication was cancelled or failed. Nothing was erased.
